name: Baltrum (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided light blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Baltrum (a yellow bell frame on a mount between stars on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Baltrum; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Baltrum arms — bell frame and stars on blue
